name: Gnoll Paw
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Gnoll Paw bounties help defend Westfall’s farmsteads from Riverpaw packs. The People's Militia pays for proof that patrols have slain gnolls.

sections.title: Bounty of the Militia
sections.body:
The People's Militia defends Westfall from Sentinel Hill. The royal army is absent, and the crown seems blind to troubles in the countryside. So ordinary citizens and volunteers face outlaws, rogue mechanoids, and Riverpaw gnolls.

Captain Danuvin offers bounties for proof that gnolls have been slain. Their paws show that patrols have searched the scrublands instead of resting beneath the watchtower.

sections.title: A Coordinated Menace
sections.body:
Riverpaw gnolls forage across Westfall’s plains. Militia observers have noticed signs that the packs coordinate closely with Defias thieves based around the Deadmines. The gnolls terrorize farmsteads and prey on supply wagons, helping shield the bandits from local resistance.

Bringing in gnoll paws helps keep the overland routes between Sentinel Hill and Elwynn Forest open.

faq.q: Why does Captain Danuvin want Gnoll Paws?
faq.answer: Captain Danuvin asks for Gnoll Paws as proof that a patrol has crossed the Westfall plains and slain gnolls. With few resources and no aid from the crown, the militia pays bounties for that evidence.
The paws come from Riverpaw gnolls that prowl Westfall’s grasslands, hills, and abandoned farms.

faq.q: Are the gnolls acting alone in Westfall?
faq.answer: No. Captain Danuvin and the militia suspect Riverpaw gnolls work with bandits and thieves based around the Deadmines. Together, they threaten local farmsteads.

faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind dealing with the gnoll threat?
aliases: why does the militia fight gnolls
faq.answer: Stormwind has left Westfall largely to its own devices amid domestic turmoil and political paralysis. Local farmers and The People's Militia bear nearly all the work of defending the countryside.

angles.text: For Alliance champions, taking bounties from The People's Militia helps keep Stormwind's western breadbasket safe from roaming beasts and organized bandits.
As a hunter, you can track Riverpaw packs across Westfall’s open plains while helping secure rural outposts.
